This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imbat]] who worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the [[Splendor Tavern]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sometime in [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to the Splendor Tavern looking for [[Helb]], a broker for the criminal group [[Tech Raiders]]. Qui-Gon spoke to the bartender, who then directed him where Helb could be found.<ref name="TDH" />
